meta.name: version-release
meta.description: Choose and apply the correct semantic version bump for this repository. Use for every user-visible release, before merge when a change set should ship as patch, minor, or major, and whenever package/plugin/desktop version metadata must stay synchronized.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发版时自动算出并写入正确的版本号
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把改动发成新版本却拿不准该升到几点几
copy.tagline_en: Pick the right semantic version and apply it before every release
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're unsure which version number to assign before shipping a release

howto.what: 装了这个技能后,Claude 会按语义化版本规则为仓库选出合适的版本号,同步更新各版本文件,并创建对应的 GitHub 里程碑,把关联的 PR 和问题一并归入,保证发布版本一致。
howto.when: 当你要发布一个用户可见的新版本、在合并前需要确定版本号是补丁/小版本/大版本,或需要保持各包/插件/桌面版本元数据同步时,这个技能就会被触发。

say.text: 这个改动是向后兼容的新功能,请按 minor 版本发布。
say.note: Claude 按 minor 更新版本并执行发布流程。

say.text: 请把版本定为 v2.0.0,并同步各处的版本文件。
say.note: 覆盖自动分类,强制同步到指定版本。

say.text: 创建 v1.5.0 的 GitHub 里程碑,并关联当前 PR 和关闭的问题。
say.note: 创建或复用同名的里程碑并分配相关项。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude selects the correct semantic version for the repo, updates all version-related files to match, creates or reuses the matching GitHub milestone, and assigns the current PR and linked issues to it, keeping the release consistent.
howto.when_en: This skill triggers when you are making a user-visible release, before merge when a change set should ship as patch, minor, or major, or whenever package/plugin/desktop version metadata must stay synchronized.

say_en.text: This change adds a backward-compatible feature; please release as a minor version.
say_en.note: Claude bumps minor and runs the release workflow.

say_en.text: Set the version to v2.0.0 and sync all version files accordingly.
say_en.note: Overrides auto-classification and syncs the exact version.

say_en.text: Create a GitHub milestone for v1.5.0 and link the current PR and closing issues.
say_en.note: Creates or reuses the milestone and assigns related items.
